verdict.rationale: Kimi is itself an AI assistant and coding agent (Kimi Code CLI, Desktop and IDE agent, Agent mode), so it takes the MCP-client role rather than serving tools to other agents. Nothing in the evidence shows Kimi running as an MCP server, such as an 'mcp serve' mode or a hosted MCP endpoint. The ACP editor protocol and plugins/skills are different capabilities and do not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
